{"metadata":{"description":"DSH web plugin: per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row — per-turn spend and cache-hit / cache-miss totals (CNY), priced from an official price table refreshed on demand. · DSH 网页插件：输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊——逐轮花费与命中/未命中两项总额（CNY），价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。","id":"gh:1416005729","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-bottom-cost","slug":"LanFeng97/dsh-bottom-cost","topics":["cost","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","pricing","token-usage"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH web plugin: per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row — per-turn spend and cache-hit "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"/ cache-miss totals (CNY), priced from an official price table refreshed on demand. · DSH 网页插件：输入框下方"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"统计栏里的会话费用胶囊——逐轮花费与命中/未命中两项总额（CNY），价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-bottom-cost"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **session cost** chip for DeepSeek Harness: it sits in the same row as the built-in stats pills un"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"der the composer and answers "what has this conversation cost" and "what did the last turn cost" at "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"a glance, splitting the spend into **cache-hit** and **cache-miss** parts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### Option 1 — install it from the DSH UI (simplest)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. Open **插件 → 添加插件** (Plugins → Add plugin) in the sidebar;
2. Type either one:
- the package name "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"**`dsh-bottom-cost`** — works everywhere, including the official desktop client (which can only inst"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"all npm sources), or
- the repository URL `https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-bottom-cost` — works on "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"`dsh web`; the market resolves it to a tarball from codeload, so a flaky network can fail it;
3. Cli"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ck **安装** (Install), then **restart DeepSeek Harness** as its banner tells you to (close the running"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" `dsh` process and start it again, e.g. `dsh web`)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The host half is a Node module, so **a config reload alone will not import it** — that restart is no"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t optional. Once restarted, open the UI and the chip is there; no page refresh needed."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Updating later is explicit.** An installation pins the exact version (the profile ends up with `"d"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"sh-bottom-cost": "0.5.1"`), so a new release reaches you when you press **更新** (Update) in the plugi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n manager — nothing changes under you in between."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Option 2 — let your AI install it"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Paste this whole block into any AI that can read and write your machine (an agent inside DSH, Claude"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" Code, Codex — anything):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Option 3 — from the plugin market (once listed)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"DSH plugins are distributed as packages; look for **dsh-bottom-cost** in dshmarket. Until it is list"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ed, use option 1 or 2."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Option 4 — from source (developers)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"For hacking on it, or for a non-default profile:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"It is idempotent — re-run it after a `git pull` to sync an update — and it resolves your DSH home th"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e way the harness does (`$DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`). This route needs a restart too. After that, cha"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nging `lib/client.js` only needs a page refresh; changing `lib/index.js` still needs a restart."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The plugin has **no runtime dependencies at all** (its shape validation is a ~90-line file it ships,"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" `lib/shape.js`), so this route installs nothing from the network. That is also why it installs by *"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"*copy** rather than a directory junction: a junction gets realpath-resolved back into the clone, so "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"any future bare import of a third-party package would fail to resolve there at load time."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Cannot install or cannot uninstall? Read this first"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**The desktop client can only install npm sources.** On the official desktop app, pasting a GitHub U"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"RL into "add plugin" may simply not install — that is the client's install boundary, not your networ"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"k (its own message says so: "This desktop client can only install plugins published to npm"). Instal"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"l by npm package name instead."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**A flaky network breaks the GitHub source.** Behind that box is pnpm: it resolves `owner/repo` to a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" commit, then downloads a tarball from `codeload.github.com`, and the resolve step has a **6-second "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"timeout**. A hiccup fails the install; retrying usually gets through."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How to read the UI"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Where the numbers come from"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Only the **official DeepSeek routes** have a published price list, so only they produce money:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| **Hit spend** | cache-read tokens × hit price |
| **Miss spend** | (uncached input + cache-write) "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"× miss price **+** output tokens × output price |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Capability boundary"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **One outbound request**, to the public docs page above, **only when you click 刷新**. Nothing else "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ever leaves the machine.
- **One file written**: `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-bottom-cost/pricebook.json`.
- The "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"three price routes are **loopback + same-origin fenced** (the same guard sibling DSH plugins use).
-"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" The host half reads no credentials, writes no session data, and runs no timers.
- The **Turn N** he"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"adings read-only drive the built-in turn navigation: they read the tick buttons' `aria-label` (which"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" carries the turn number) and `aria-current`, and invoke the tick's own click. If the rail is unavai"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"lable it falls back to the `data-chat-turn` anchors on transcript rows. The plugin injects no nodes,"},{"id":"p30s8","text":" changes no layout, and hardcodes no build-hashed class names — but if those semantic attributes eve"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"r change, jumping breaks and the panel reports the failure instead of failing silently."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Why the shape validation is hand-rolled"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"DSH's projection registry asks each unit for a `stateSchema` and a `wire.viewSchema`, and **only eve"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"r calls `.parse` on them** (six call sites in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection`; no `safeParse`,"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" no `optional`, no `refine`). That contract is duck-typed, so `lib/shape.js` implements exactly the "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"seven predicates this plugin needs — object, string, finite number, boolean, array, enum, nullable —"},{"id":"p32s5","text":" in about 90 dependency-free lines."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The alternative was `zod`, as DSH's own `dsh-token-meter` uses. It is not wrong, but for this plugin"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" it loses: the published package is 840 files / 5.86 MB (even a trimmed v4-ESM subset is 111 files /"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" 886 KB), and the README's primary install path is a *copy* install that does not bring dependencies"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" along — so shipping zod would mean either a large vendored blob, or a pnpm/network step that rewrit"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"es your profile's `package.json`. Hand-rolling keeps that path genuinely self-contained. It is sligh"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"tly *stricter* than zod in one place: `NaN` and `Infinity` are rejected (they would silently poison "},{"id":"p33s7","text":"a running total), and it is covered by the self-test suite directly — which zod, being a third-party"},{"id":"p33s8","text":" import, could not be."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- DSH **≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** (built and verified against 0.2.0-rc.2).
- Node **≥ 20**.
- **No runtime depe"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ndencies.** The projection schemas are validated by the plugin's own `lib/shape.js`."}],"truncated":true}
